remarks: Unique opportunity! Luxury 2BR/2BA Condo with separate storage room in Downtown Stamford. Experience modern city living in this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo in a sought-after building. This spacious home features an open-concept layout and a sunlit living area that opens to a private balcony. The primary suite boasts a walk-in closet and spa-like en-suite bath, and the second bedroom offers ample storage with the large closet.  Enjoy in-unit laundry, a gorgeous, recently updated kitchen, and exclusive building amenities, including a doorman, gym, private park, courtyard with grills, and a clubroom. Includes two garage parking spaces (one assigned) and is one of a few units with it's own, separate, large storage room.  Prime location across from Mill River Park, near UConn Stamford, restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and transit. 12+ month lease, tenant pays utilities, excellent credit & proof of income required. Up to 2 cats allowed (pet fee applies).  Schedule your viewing today!
